content.title: 2025 Election Results
content.summary: In the 2025 city council elections, Michael P. Griffith won the at-large seat with 61.3% of the votes, while Randy Moorman and Rebecka Lovisone secured victories in Districts 1 and 3, respectively. Additionally, a ballot measure to amend the Arvada City Charter regarding the residency requirement for Municipal Court judges was rejected, with 63.3% voting against it.

## Ballot Measure

### QUESTION No. 3 G - AMENDMENT TO THE CHARTER FOR THE CITY OF ARVADA

Shall Chapter VIII, Section 8.2, “Judiciary,” of the Arvada City Charter be amended to remove the requirement that each judge of the Municipal Court be a resident of the City of Arvada?

| Question No. 3G | Total Votes | Percentage of Votes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | 16,057 | 36.7% |
| No | 27,713 | 63.3% |
